title: The Country House Adventure
introduction: Explore the house. Type 'help' for commands, or 'quit' to leave.

rooms.name: Entrance Hall
rooms.description: A broad oak staircase rises beneath a painted ceiling. Doors lead into the principal rooms.

rooms.name: Drawing Room
rooms.description: Tall sash windows overlook the garden, and a fire glows in the marble hearth.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.description: A long mahogany table is set beneath a sparkling chandelier.

rooms.name: Great Hall
rooms.description: Antlers and old portraits decorate this lofty room, where a stone fireplace dominates the north wall.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Floor-to-ceiling shelves hold leather-bound books and a brass reading lamp.

rooms.name: Morning Room
rooms.description: A comfortable, sunlit room opens onto the terrace.

rooms.name: Conservatory
rooms.description: Glass walls enclose a riot of ferns, palms, and flowering plants.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: Copper pans hang above a large worktable in the heart of the household.

rooms.name: Pantry
rooms.description: Shelves are neatly stocked with jars, preserves, and dry goods.

rooms.name: Servants' Hall
rooms.description: A plain table and a row of coat hooks serve the household staff.

rooms.name: Main Staircase
rooms.description: The staircase curves up to a quiet landing and the private rooms above.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.description: A four-poster bed stands between tall wardrobes and a small writing desk.
